composition_variation: Create an original anime illustration of a 29-year-old woman pausing on a small stone bridge with a melon soda after a summer walk. Her mature face is exceptionally graceful, with blue-gray almond eyes, softly structured brows, a refined nose, subtle cheekbone definition, and a gentle relaxed smile. Pale golden-blonde curls fall behind her shoulders, swept neatly away from her face. She wears an opaque sage-green short-sleeved blouse with a modest square neckline, white tailored linen trousers, tan sandals, and small round gold earrings. She stands beside the bridge parapet, holding a clear cup of pale-green soda close to her abdomen with one hand while her other forearm rests lightly on the stone. She looks toward the water rather than striking a dramatic pose. Keep the cup free of branding and the straw unused. Below the bridge, quiet canal reflections and a few lily pads add cool color; distant cream facades remain soft and low. Evening sunlight creates warm gold edges against mint and pale stone. Use refined facial detail, realistic relaxed shoulders, and gentle painterly atmosphere. Use an eye-level portrait composition, with one person centered in the middle-to-lower frame and hands held within the central crop. Leave the upper quarter as clean pale sky or light for the lock-screen clock.
